===============
Python OOPS
===============
** OOPS = Object Oriented Programming System
** OOPS is a programming approach where we design software using classes and objects.
** In real life, everything can be treated as an object.
Student -------> name, email, phno, course, fee
Employee ------> id, name, salary, project
Bank Account ----> account number, balance, branch name, deposit, withdraw
** Without OOPS, we usually write multiple variables and functions separately like below...
